title: Manager, Security Consulting

sections.minimum_qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Technology Management, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or Information Systems, or a related field and 5 years of progressive post-baccalaureate experience in the job offered or in a Security Consulting-related occupation.
- Alternatively, will accept a Master’s degree in Technology Management, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, and 3 years of experience in the job offered or in a Security Consulting-related occupation.
- Position requires 3 years of experience in the following: Cybersecurity solution assessment across multiple security domains or Cybersecurity architecture review; Cybersecurity program development utilizing systems thinking or Development of security strategy and roadmaps; Executive influencing for the adoption of proposed cybersecurity solutions or Executive stakeholder management for security investments; Consulting with stakeholders using structured discovery to define cybersecurity requirements or Security requirements gathering and analysis; and Project management of cybersecurity initiatives or Program management of security portfolios.
sections.about:
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
The US base salary range for this full-time position is $168,000 - $244,000 + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits determined by role, level, and location. Individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Learn more about benefits at Google.
Position reports to the Google office & may allow for a hybrid schedule as per Google policy.
sections.responsibilities:
- Develop strategic roadmaps and recommendations to enhance client cloud security architecture, governance, and standards based on leading industry practices.
- Lead client engagements as the primary subject matter expert, overseeing project execution, managing escalations, and communicating deliverables to all stakeholders.
- Cultivate strategic relationships with senior client and internal stakeholders to secure buy-in, advise on technology use, and identify new business opportunities.
- Mentor junior team members and coach internal and external teams on new solutions, technical skills, and industry best practices to foster growth.
- Drive technical innovation by creating repeatable solutions, best practice recommendations, and other content to improve engagement execution and operational efficiency. Contribute to the technical vision and long-term goals of the team, leading change initiatives to meet evolving customer and organizational needs. Domestic travel of more than 10% is required.
